title: N.I.H. Will Move Final Group of Retired Research Chimps to Sanctuary
summary: The National Institutes of Health, which stopped supporting invasive research on chimpanzees in 2015, previously said the animals were too old and frail to move.
caption: Chimpanzees lounging at Chimp Haven, a sanctuary in Keithville, La. More than two dozen chimps from a research center in Texas will join them next year.

title: How to Travel with Older Adults
summary: Aging issues — like changes in mobility, cognition and medical needs — seem to affect not whether many older people travel, but how. Here are some tips on how to vacation together.
